title: Decoding Austin's CodeNEXT
summary:
*   A community town hall event, "ATX Together: Decoding CodeNEXT," was held to discuss Austin's proposed new land development code.
*   This public discussion offered residents an opportunity to understand and engage with the details of CodeNEXT.
*   Though council members might be present, no official actions, votes, or policy decisions were made during this informational session.
